description: Stationnement sur la voie publique is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. La couche stationnement sur la voie publique recense les places de stationnement sur la voie publique destinées aux véhicules motorisés et non motorisés. Chaque vecteur représente un nombre de place ayant un type de stationnement défini par son statut et sa durée. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
